rows.grounds: compound describing the opening as furnished with external water
aperture or hollow space in the structure
prescriptive instruction for designing the feature

items.question: Should the brahmāṅkaṇa's aperture be designed with external water or as a simple opening?
premises: The brahmāṅkaṇa may be constructed with an aperture.
One option provides the aperture with external water.
Another option leaves the aperture as a plain opening.
items.inference: Therefore the designer may arrange the aperture either with external water or as a simple opening.
items.plain_english: One should arrange it either as an opening furnished with external water or as a plain opening.
